reference_sql:
SELECT channel,
       order_month,
       COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS n_orders,
       SUM(net_revenue_eur) AS revenue_eur,
       SUM(net_revenue_eur) / COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS avg_order_value_eur
FROM sales
WHERE order_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2025-03-31'
GROUP BY channel, order_month
ORDER BY channel, order_month
